move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.
Thank you for your quotation for the new HX pump shaft. You have told us you have room in your second shift and see us as a reference customer; this series could fill that capacity steadily over the full contract. We also owe you on-time payment, and we commit to it. Below is our proposal, based on our own cost model and recent material movements.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 36.87 per unit (cost:320070).

Your rolling scorecard shows 1863 ppm defects (sc:70210@2026Q3).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

decisions.hold: it clarifies internally - our proposal stands

decisions.why: best after 2 auction call(s); C 242,212 below the limit 305,545

key_points: RFQ for a new part, leverage goal: two eager small shops with idle capacity (Dralveck, Fuchsreiter) and one fully booked shop (Hrvelec) that is unlikely to compete hard.
Should-cost puts the full cost at about the current/fallback price. Use it as a checkable anchor with the eager shops, not with Hrvelec.

Falling-index records (bars over the last quarter, alloy surcharge over the last quarter, power over twelve months) are our fresh-fact fillers. Each counts once per case, so spread different records across suppliers and rounds and never use the peak figures.
Payment: both eager shops want cash. Commit to on-time payment from the start and hold the move to payment in fourteen days for the last round as the price trade.
Lead time must stay at or below forty-two days. With spare capacity, offer the standard thirty-five days and do not pay for twenty-eight. With Hrvelec, accept forty-two.
Volume and contract term are fixed and binding, so present the award itself (the full need, binding, over two years) as the volume currency.
Evidence on the suppliers' own HX cost bases is thin. The should-cost models a German plant.
plan.stance_why: This is a leverage RFQ with two eager, idle-capacity shops competing for a new series part. Lessons show that deep anchors give lower landings in such cases. The tone stays warm, and the anchor is softened toward Hrvelec, which is capacity-constrained.

levers.why: Checkable anchor for the new part. Its costing is stale, so a bottom-up figure frames the bid.

argument.sentence: Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 36.87 per unit (cost:320070).
argument.note: Should-cost EUR 36.87 per unit (a German cost base, error about 10%); no current price of this supplier found.

levers.why: Alloy surcharge fell recently; checkable and counters its material story.

argument.sentence: Alloy surcharge Isartal Edelstahlwerk changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
argument.note: AS-14404 (Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived)): -5.5% largest fall within 12 months (2026-06 to 2026-09); 16% of the part's cost, so about -0.88% on the price.

levers.why: Ties the HX award to its idle second shift.

argument.sentence: We would also welcome your view on the points from our call about "Capacity" (doc:20260722-70210-M2).
argument.note: call_note 2026-07-22 by Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing: Call with sales at Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: they could take additional parts at short notice; the second shift has been on hold since spring.

levers.why: Fresh fact: bar prices have eased in recent months.

risks: With no fallback supplier, failing to reach a deal costs the fallback price, so do not overplay the deep anchor or push past a final offer.
Our should-cost is only slightly above the current/fallback price, so pushing deep below it may squeeze small shops and harm quality and delivery.
Dralveck's high ppm and slipping delivery add defect and lateness costs, so compare bids on total cost, not price alone.
Our late-payment record undermines trust with both eager shops unless on-time payment is visibly committed.
